rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) suffered bodily injury (broken wrist) on the policyholder's property due to a hazardous condition (icy walkway) created by weather on the policyholder's premises.
claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor's child slipped on an icy walkway in front of the policyholder's house during last week's ice storm and broke her wrist. Parents are pursuing medical bills. Liability coverage applies with $500,000 limit.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped and fell on icy walkway
case_facts.claimed_loss: medical bills from broken wrist injury
